1181: O God, You alone have given every being its soul, breath and body.
Setting Your light within them, You make fools beautiful.
O God, all are beggars at Your door; You are kind to all.
Repeating Your Name, beings become glad at heart. ॥1॥
O my Beloved, You who have power to do all things,
ਹਉ ਪਾਵਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ; ਸਗਲ ਥੋਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
from You alone I receive every good thing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Repeating the Name, one is carried across,
repeating the Name, one gains the finest comforts of stillness of mind,
repeating the Name, one gains honour and good repute,
repeating the Name, no obstacle blocks the way. ॥2॥
O my Lord, the Name for whose sake this rare human body was given,
that Name, my Lord, grant me.
May this mind of mine keep its dwelling in the company of the holy.
ਸਦਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
O God, may I ever repeat Your Name in my heart. ॥3॥
O God, apart from You I have no other support.
ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਖੇਲੁ; ਤੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
This whole play of the world is Yours, and all beings merge back into You.
As it pleases You, so protect me.
O Nanak, the one who meets the perfect Guru gains spiritual bliss. ॥4॥4॥
The beloved Lord, God the King, dwells always with me,
O mother, the One by seeing whom I may gain spiritual life,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
through whose remembrance no sorrow can touch me:
in Your mercy, unite me with Him. ॥1॥
O my beloved Lord, support of my life and mind,
ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਧਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
this soul and this breath are all wealth given by You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ; ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
O mother, the God whom men of godly virtue and the gods keep seeking,
ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ; ਨ ਲਹਹਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
whose secret neither the sages nor Shesh Naag can find,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
whose high state and greatness cannot be described,
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ; ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
that God pervades every single body. ॥2॥
O mother, the God whose devotees are ever full of bliss,
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਖੈ ॥
whose devotees never meet spiritual death,
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਭੈ ॥
whose devotees no fear of the world can touch,
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਜੈ ॥੩॥
whose devotees always win against the vices, He dwells in every body. ॥3॥
O God, no likeness of You can be told.
You are the Master who gives comfort to all, present in every place.
O God, Nanak begs You for a single gift:
in Your mercy, grant me Your Name. ॥4॥5॥
As plants turn green on meeting water,
so in the company of the holy pride comes to an end.
As a servant draws courage from his master,
so the Guru is the support for carrying beings across. ॥1॥
O God, You are the Giver able to give all things.
Moment by moment I bow to Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one who is granted the company of the Guru,
that person is dyed in the love of the Supreme Lord.
Such people win release from the bonds of attachment to Maya.
The devotees remember the Lord's Name; this is the true way of union with Him. ॥2॥
Beholding God's sight, the eyes are satisfied and no longer crave another's form.
As the tongue sings God's countless virtues,
by the Guru's grace the fire of craving is quenched,
and the mind is sated by the taste of the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
O Lord, the servant who applies himself to serving Your feet,
O Source of all, all-pervading Lord, beyond the beyond, Lord of light,
Your Name carries all beings across.
Nanak has received this treasure of Your Name. ॥4॥6॥
O God, You are the greatest Giver, ever giving to all,
and You pervade the soul and breath of every being.
You give all things to eat,
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ; ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
but I, without virtue, have not understood a single kindness of Yours. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਨਉ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
I know nothing at all of Your worth,
1182: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O kind Lord, raise me to a high spiritual state. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾਪ ਨ ਤਾਪ; ਨ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਤਿ ॥
O God, I have done no chanting, no austerity, no prescribed religious rites;
I do not even know how to keep any religious custom.
But, O God, I hold only this one hope in my mind,
that with the support of Your Name I will cross over. ॥2॥
O God, You are complete in every power.
We cannot find Your limit, as the fish in the water cannot find the ocean's.
O God, You are beyond reach, beyond reach, higher than the highest.
We are small of heart; You are vast of heart. ॥3॥
O God, those who have remembered Your Name are the truly wealthy,
those who have found You are the truly rich.
Everyone who has worshipped You is at peace,
O Nanak, they remain in the shelter of Your saints. ॥4॥7॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿ; ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥
Serve the God who created you.
Remember the One who gave you life.
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਡਾਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
If you remain His servant, no penalty can fall on you.
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੋਤਦਾਰੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
Be only a steward of His stores, and then no sorrow will touch you. ॥1॥
The person whose fortune is very great,
ਸੋ ਪਾਏ; ਇਹੁ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that person attains this state where no desire can touch him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In serving another, life goes to waste,
ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
and not a single need is fulfilled.
Serving the Guru always brings comfort. ॥2॥
If you wish for lasting spiritual bliss,
the Guru has said: keep the company of the holy.
There only the Lord's Name is repeated,
and in the company of the holy one becomes able to cross the world's ocean. ॥3॥
Of all reflections, the highest is to come to know God.
Of all absorptions, the best is to keep one's attention fixed on God.
Joining one's attention to the Lord's praise is the finest of all deeds.
O Nanak, meet the Guru and keep singing His virtues. ॥4॥8॥
Utter the Lord's Name, uttering which the mouth becomes pure,
remembering which one gains spotless repute,
ਜਿਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ; ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ. ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
worshipping which the messenger of death can say nothing,
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
and by whose service one obtains everything needed. ॥1॥
Utter always the Name of the Lord, utter the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ; ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Give up all the other desires of your mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Remember the God by whom earth and sky are held in place,
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
whose light is in every body,
remembering whom even a sinful person becomes pure of life,
ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ. ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
and by whose grace one does not grieve again and again at the end. ॥2॥
Of all religious duties, remembering the Name is the highest duty,
and this deed is above all other religious deeds.
ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਹਿ; ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
Remember the God whom men of godly virtue and the gods long to meet.
Apply yourself to serving the company of the holy. ॥3॥
The one on whom the Source of all, the all-pervading Lord, bestowed His gift,
that one received the treasure of the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
What such a one is like, and how great, cannot be told.
O servant Nanak, ever remember the Lord. ॥4॥9॥
Now a longing for the Lord's Name has taken hold in my mind and body.
The kind Guru has fulfilled my long-held hope.
In the company of the Guru my sins have been cut away,
for, steeped in love, I am repeating the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
By the Guru's grace, the bloom of spring has come within me.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have set the Lord's lovely feet in my heart, and now I hear the Lord's praise always. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1183: O Master of all powers, O Lord, O Source of the world,
O God, I, without a protector, have come to Your shelter.
O God, all beings and creatures rest on Your support.
In Your mercy, O God, carry them across. ॥2॥
The Lord who cuts the round of birth and death, destroys sorrow and is all light,
ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
men of godly virtue and sages serve Him in devotion.
ਧਰਣਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Earth and sky rest on His power.
O God, all creatures eat what You give. ॥3॥
O kind God, Knower of all hearts,
look on Your servant with a glance of grace.
In Your mercy, grant me this gift,
that Nanak may gain spiritual life by repeating Your Name. ॥4॥10॥
In the Lord's love all sins are wiped away,
repeating the Lord's Name no affliction can touch one,
repeating the Name of Gobind all the darkness of attachment to Maya is dispelled,
remembering the Lord, the rounds of birth and death come to an end. ॥1॥
Now love for the Lord has formed within me, and my heart has come into bloom.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ; ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace I keep the company of the saints always. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The saints have given this teaching,
ਜਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ; ਸੋ ਧੰਨਿ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
that the land where the Lord's devotee dwells is blessed,
and a place empty of the Lord's devotion is a wilderness.
By the Guru's grace, know Him to dwell in every body. ॥2॥
O my mind, take the Lord's praise to be the joy of all the world's pleasures.
ਮਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ; ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
O mind, always hold back from committing sin.
See the Lord, who can do all things, dwelling near you.
God alone sets right all affairs, here and hereafter. ॥3॥
That person's attention is fixed on the Lord's lovely feet
on whom God, in His mercy, has bestowed His gift.
ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
I beg for the dust of the feet of Your saints,
so that, O Lord, Nanak may keep repeating Your Name, knowing You ever present. ॥4॥11॥
God is eternal, and ever new.
By the Guru's grace I utter His Name always.
As a mother and father watch over their child, so God is ever my protector,
the God through whose remembrance no affliction can touch one. ॥1॥
ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ; ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
Now, with a single mind and in His love alone, I keep remembering the Master,
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I stay always in the shelter of the perfect Guru, and the eternal Master has held me to His bosom and protected me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God Himself has protected His servants.
Their wicked enemies all wander and wander and are worn out.
Apart from the true Guru, the form of the eternal Lord, they have no other support.
Those who leave the Guru and wander from land to land meet sorrow. ॥2॥
The imprint of what they have done is not wiped away.
They themselves eat the fruit of what they have sown.
The Lord Himself becomes His servant's protector.
ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਪਹੁਚਿ. ਨ ਸਕਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
No one can match the Lord's servant. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ; ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
God has made His own effort and Himself protected His servants,
He whose glory is unbroken and complete.
Sing the virtues of that Gobind with your tongue always.
Nanak too gains spiritual life by meditating on the Lord's feet. ॥4॥12॥
Keeping the Guru's feet in his heart, that person's every sorrow departs
on whom the Supreme Lord God has shown mercy.
All his wishes and all his tasks are fulfilled.
Nanak too gains spiritual life by repeating the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਸਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
That season is lovely in which the Lord comes to dwell in one's mind.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਂਤੀ; ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the true Guru the world is seen wailing; one cut off from God is born and dies again and again. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1184: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Those within whom is the capital of the Lord's Name are the wealthy ones.
Through the Guru's word, lust and anger are destroyed within them.
Their fears depart and they reach the state that no fear can touch.
Meeting the Guru, Nanak too has remembered the Master. ॥2॥
The person whom God has given a dwelling in the company of the holy,
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ; ਹੋਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥
repeating the Lord's Name over and over, has every hope fulfilled.
That Lord pervades water, land and sky.
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
Meeting the Guru, Nanak too has remembered Him. ॥3॥
This Name is itself the eight powers of the adepts and the nine treasures.
It is received through His grace by the one to whom God gives it.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
O God, Your servants gain spiritual life by repeating Your Name over and over.
O Nanak, meeting the Guru, the lotus of their heart stays in bloom. ॥4॥13॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Repeating the Name, all their wishes were fulfilled,
and God united with Himself even those long separated. ॥1॥
Remember Gobind, who is worthy of remembrance,
ਜਿਤੁ ਰਵਿਐ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for when He is remembered one tastes the comforts of stillness of mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In His mercy He has always looked upon His servant with a glance of grace,
and God Himself has taken care of His own servant. ॥2॥
Through the taste of union with God, the bed of the heart becomes lovely
for the one whom God, the Master of comforts, comes and meets. ॥3॥
God did not weigh my virtues, nor did He weigh my faults;
O Nanak, He has made me a worshipper of His feet. ॥4॥1॥14॥
Whoever sings the Lord's virtues, all his sins are destroyed,
and a current of stillness of mind wells up in him day and night. ॥1॥
That servant's mind, joined to the Lord's feet, comes alive in spirit,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭੇਟੇ; ਨਿਤ ਰਾਤੌ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the servant whom the Lord in mercy lets meet the Guru, is ever dyed in the colour of the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one in whose heart Gopal in His mercy becomes manifest,
the Lord, kind to the meek, attaches to His hem and carries across. ॥2॥
The person whose mind becomes the dust of the Guru's feet
sees the Lord dwelling ever present with him. ॥3॥
Lust, anger and craving depart from within that person
on whom, O Nanak, God's mercy falls. ॥4॥2॥15॥
God Himself removes the ailments of those who come to the perfect Guru,
and protects those children, patting them with His own hands. ॥1॥
Peace and stillness of mind remain in the home of their heart, and a lasting bloom,
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ; ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰੂਪ. ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
they who come to the shelter of the perfect Guru and repeat the mantra of the Name of the Lord, the form of all comfort. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God Himself has cut away the worries and afflictions of those who came to the perfect Guru.
ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
You too, remember your Guru always, always. ॥2॥
O God, the person who repeats Your Name
ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
gains all rewards by singing Your everlasting virtues. ॥3॥
O Nanak, this is the fine way of life of the devotees,
that they keep repeating the Name of the Giver of comfort always. ॥4॥3॥16॥
By His own command the Lord keeps His servants glad at heart.
He is always kind to His servants. ॥1॥
The perfect Guru brought every task of that person to completion,
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in whose heart He set the Lord's Name, which gives spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
The Guru did not weigh my deeds or my religious duty;
1185: taking me by the arm, He has carried me across the world's ocean of vices. ॥2॥
God Himself cut away their filth and made them pure of life,
those who fell into the shelter of the perfect Guru. ॥3॥
O Lord, able to do all things, You Yourself are doing everything.
In Your mercy, carry me, Nanak, across. ॥4॥4॥17॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
See, flowers upon flowers have bloomed within you.
O my mind, cast out pride, cast out pride,
and cling to the Lord's lovely feet.
O fortunate mind, stay joined to God.
O my mind, keep remembering the Lord. ॥ Rahao ॥
When spring comes, the trees grow dense with shade, fragrant and tender,
yet some remain dry, hard as dead wood.
So too the season of human life has come to you, in which the soul can bloom,
yet only the fortunate one who repeats the Name can stay in bloom. ॥1॥
O my mind, now with human birth the time for sowing the Name has come to you.
Sow only the Name, sow only the Name.
In no other birth can the Name be sown, it cannot be sown.
O my mind, take care not to stray from the path in the chase after Maya.
Only by meeting the Guru is the Lord's Name obtained,
by the person on whose forehead the writ of the Name shines forth.
O mind, this human life is the season for sowing the Name;
ਗੁਨ ਕਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
O Nanak, only one who has sown it utters the Lord's virtues always. ॥2॥18॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ. ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
O my brothers, gather together in the company of the holy, and joining your attention to the Lord, wipe out the sense of mine and yours.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜੋੜੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸਫਾ ਵਿਛਾਇ ॥੧॥
Become partners in the game of the Lord's Name, and spread the cloth of staying in the Guru's shelter and settle your mind. ॥1॥
O brother, throw the dice in this way:
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ. ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through the Guru, repeat the Name day and night, and at life's end no pain will strike you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਸਾਜਹੁ; ਸਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Make good deeds your board game, and make high conduct your pieces.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੀਤਹੁ; ਐਸੀ ਖੇਲ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
Bring lust, anger, greed and attachment under control; such a game is dear to the Lord. ॥2॥
ਉਠਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ; ਸੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
Rise at the ambrosial hour and bathe in the Name, and even in sleep stay joined in worship of the Lord.
ਬਿਖੜੇ ਦਾਉ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
My true Guru brings them through the hard moves, and they abide at God's feet in the comfort of stillness of mind. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੈ. ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
The Lord Himself plays the game, Himself watches it, and has Himself made this creation.

O God, You alone know Your power; no other understands it.

O God, the place where You dwell is ever lovely, and Your wonders are without end. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ. ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ; ਅਉਰੁ. ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
O God, devotion to You comes about only by Your prompting; no one else can perform it.

He alone becomes Your devotee who is pleasing to You, whom You dye in the colour of Your love. ॥2॥
1186: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ. ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਨਾ; ਅਉਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
You are the great Giver, You are supremely wise; there is no other like You.
ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ; ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੩॥
You are my all-powerful Master; what do I know of worshipping You? ॥3॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Your mansion is beyond the reach of the senses, my Beloved; hard it is to walk in Your will.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਢਹਿ ਪਇਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ; ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
Says Nanak, I have collapsed at Your door; save me, foolish and ignorant as I am. ॥4॥2॥20॥
ਮੂਲੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ, ਆਪੁ. ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਭਰਮਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ, ਅਹੰ ਮਨੀ ॥੧॥
One does not understand the root, nor know oneself; the mind is caught in wandering through ego. ॥1॥
O Father, transcendent Lord God, my Master,
carry me across, worthless as I am. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ; ਇਹ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੀ ॥੨॥

ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸੇ ਗਨੀ ॥੩॥
Those imbued with love of God's Name — I count them as the happy ones in this Dark Age. ॥3॥
ਅਵਰੁ ਉਪਾਉ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੧॥
I can think of no other way; Nanak, one crosses over only through the Guru's words. ॥4॥3॥21॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace

the Lord who dwells within it — recognise Him alone as true. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥

This world is like wealth found in a dream; why are you so proud on seeing it?
ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਚਾਲੈ; ਤਾਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
Nothing of it will go along with you; why do you cling to it? ॥1॥
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਪਰਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੋ ॥
Abandon both flattery and slander; enshrine the Lord's praise in your heart.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ; ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
Servant Nanak, the one primal Being, the Lord, pervades all. ॥2॥1॥
Lust, which leads to sin, dwells in the heart;
ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ; ਯਾ ਤੇ. ਗਹਿਓ, ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so the fickle mind cannot be held in check. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਭ ਹੀ ਪਰਿ; ਡਾਰੀ ਇਹ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥
over all of them this noose has been cast. ॥1॥
ਜਿਹਿ ਜਿਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥

Servant Nanak seeks the Lord's sanctuary:

ਮਾਈ ਮੈ; ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
O mother, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name;

ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੀ; ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Attachment to wealth has left my body, and immaculate spiritual wisdom has welled up within.

Greed and attachment cannot touch me; I have grasped devotion to the Lord. ॥1॥

The anxiety of countless births is ended since I obtained the jewel of the Name.
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ; ਨਿਜ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
All craving has left my mind, and I am absorbed in my own inner peace. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਸੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
One to whom the Lord, the treasure of mercy, is kind sings the praises of the Lord of the universe.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀ ਸੰਪੈ; ਕੋਊ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
Says Nanak, only a rare Guru-facing one obtains wealth of this kind. ॥3॥3॥
O mind, why have you forgotten the Lord's Name?
ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਰੈ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When the body perishes, you will have to deal with the messenger of death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
This world is a mountain of smoke;
1187: what were you thinking, to take it as real? ॥1॥
ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਚਾਲੈ; ਸਮਝ ਲੇਹ ॥੨॥
none of it goes with you; understand this well. ॥2॥
Only devotion to the Lord stays with you;
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਜੁ; ਤਿਹ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥੪॥
says Nanak, meditate on Him with single-minded love. ॥3॥4॥
ਕਹਾ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਰੇ; ਝੂਠੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਾਗ ॥

ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨ; ਅਜਹੁ ਜਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Nothing is lost yet — wake up even now. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥

accept as true that it perishes in an instant. ॥1॥
The Lord dwells with you always;
meditate on Him day and night, my friend. ॥2॥
At the very last moment He becomes your help;
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥੫॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
One who does not keep the Name in mind is a crow of the world;
forgetting the Name, he swoops on the bait — see!
His mind wavers, and there is deceit in his consciousness;
his false love of the world breaks off. ॥1॥
Lust and anger are poison, a crushing load;
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
without the Name, how can one have virtuous conduct? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Like a house of sand in a whirlpool,
or a bubble formed in the rain —
ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਤੇ; ਧਰਿ ਚਕੁ ਫੇਰਿ ॥
so is the body, shaped from a mere drop by turning the potter's wheel.
Make yourself a servant of the Name of the One whose light is in all. ॥2॥
Having created all, You are the supreme Guru over all;
may I worship You and stay at Your feet.
Imbued with Your Name, I long for Your support;
one who keeps the Name away as he goes through life is a thief. ॥3॥
One who gathers poison in his lap loses his honour;
ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੋ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
one imbued with the True Name goes home with honour.
Whatever God does, He does in His own will;
one who lives in His fear becomes fearless, O my mother. ॥4॥
but betel leaves, flowers and sweet delicacies bring only disease.
The more she plays and rejoices, the more she suffers sorrow;
one who enters God's sanctuary accepts that what He does comes to pass. ॥5॥
She wears fine clothes and adorns herself lavishly;
the body of clay swells with pride, and her beauty leads her into vice.
Hopes and desires have shut the door;
without the Name, the home of her heart is desolate. ॥6॥
Rise and act, O daughter, princess of the King;
cherishing the early dawn, chant the True Name.
Serve your Beloved, with God's love as your support;
through the Guru's Word, quench the poison of craving. ॥7॥
O Enticer, You have enticed my mind;
through the Guru's Word, may I recognise You.
Nanak: standing at God's door, we long for You;
show mercy, that we may be content in Your Name. ॥8॥1॥
The mind, gone astray, wanders, coming and going;
it is utterly lured by greed for treacherous wealth.
It never appears steady in love of the One;
like a fish, it gets the hook caught in its throat. ॥1॥
The mind gone astray comes to understand through the True Name;
reflecting on the Guru's Word, it rests in intuitive poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1188: The mind gone astray wanders like a bumblebee;
through the senses it longs for many useless vices.
Like an elephant in lust, it is trapped;
bound tight in chains, it is struck on the head. ॥2॥
The foolish mind is a frog, devoid of devotion;
cast out from the Lord's door and cursed, it is without the Name.
ਤਾ ਕੈ. ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਤੀ; ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨ ॥
Such a one has neither social class nor honour; no one even utters his name;

ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਠਾਕਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
The mind is fickle; hold it back so it does not run off.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ; ਪਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
Without being imbued with the Lord's essence, there is neither honour nor trust.
You Yourself are the listener, You Yourself the protector;
having established the earth, You Yourself watch over it and know it. ॥4॥
He Himself leads astray; to whom else can I go and speak?
He unites one with the Guru, and to the Guru I tell my pain, O mother.
I cast off my faults and practise virtue;
imbued with the Guru's Word, one merges in the True One. ॥5॥
Meeting the True Guru, the intellect is exalted;
the mind becomes pure, washing away ego.
ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ; ਬੰਧਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
One is forever liberated, and no one can bind him;

ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ; ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
The mind comes and goes according to the Lord's will;
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

His command pervades all, and all are bound by His command;

ਤੂ ਅਭੁਲੁ; ਨ ਭੂਲੌ ਕਦੇ. ਨਾਹਿ ॥

One to whom the Guru recites His Word gains profound understanding.
You, the great Master, dwell in the Word;
Nanak's mind is won over, praising the True One. ॥8॥2॥
ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ; ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
The person who thirsts for the Lord's sight

So many cry out for Your sight;
ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਚੀਨਸਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
only a rare one, united through the Guru's Word, recognises You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Vedas, in their exposition, say that the One alone is to be spoken of —
He is infinite; who has found His limit?
There is only one Creator, who made the world;
without any visible support, He holds up the earth and sky. ॥2॥
The One alone is true wisdom and meditation, the melody of His Word;
the One needs no support; His story is beyond telling.
The one Word is the true insignia;
the wise learn this from the perfect Guru. ॥3॥
Whoever firmly holds the one faith of truth
becomes steady through the Guru's teaching, age after age.
Imbued with the eternal Lord, attuned to the One with unbroken focus,

There is one throne and one King;
He pervades all places, free of care.
The three worlds are His making, and He is their essence;
He is inaccessible, beyond the senses, the One Creator. ॥5॥
His is the one form, His Name is true;
Those whose conduct is true are honoured and approved;
they receive honour in the True Court. ॥6॥
The one devotion is love for the One;
without fear and devotion, one keeps coming and going.
One who learns from the Guru and lives as a guest in this world,
1189: imbued with the Lord's essence — that humble being is approved. ॥7॥
Here and there I see You, and in poise I delight in You;

without You, my Master, I love no one else.
Nanak, the one who has burnt away ego through the Word —
the True Guru has shown him the vision of the True Lord. ॥8॥3॥
The fickle mind cannot find its way across;

ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਕੋ ਕਰੈ. ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
without the Beloved, no one cares for us. ॥1॥
All are exalted; whom could I call low?
ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One is fulfilled by devotion to the Lord and by the True Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I have grown weary of trying so many remedies;

The disease is so great — how can I find comfort?

My mind and body are full of faults;

ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਦਾਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
The Guru's Word, the Lord's Name, is the medicine;

ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ; ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
The Guru, who sees the Lord's home within the home of the heart and reveals it to others,

ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ; ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥

They remain beyond joy and sorrow;
tasting the nectar, they dwell in the Lord's Name.
One who recognises oneself remains lovingly attuned;

The Guru has given me the True Nectar, and I drink it;

The pleasure-seeker is afflicted by pain and disease;

one to whom God is seen pervading each and every heart

O fool, why have you forgotten the Lord's Name?
ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ; ਤੇਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

Consult the Guru and reflect on it:
wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਆਖਾ; ਜਾਂ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥

ਕਾਹੇ ਮਾਲੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਗਰਬਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Why are you proud on seeing your property and wealth?
When you depart, nothing will be yours. ॥4॥
Subdue the five passions and keep your mind in its place;
this is the foundation of the way to union. ॥5॥
Ego is the hobble on your mind;
ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
you do not remember the Lord, O fool — only through Him is liberation. ॥6॥
ਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ; ਜਮ ਵਸਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Beware: forgetting the Lord, you may fall into the grip of death,
and at the very end, O fool, you will be beaten. ॥7॥
1190: Reflect on the Guru's Word, and self-conceit will go;
true union will come to dwell in your mind. ॥8॥
ਜਿਨਿ. ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
You do not remember the One who gave you soul and body;
O fool, sitting in graveyards and cremation grounds is not union. ॥9॥
Nanak utters the praises, the beautiful Word;
open your eyes and recognise it. ॥10॥5॥
Duality and evil intellect lead to blind deeds;
the self-willed one wanders in the midst of darkness. ॥1॥
The blind mind follows a blind intellect;
ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
without doing the Guru's work, doubt does not depart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The blind self-willed do not like the Guru's teaching;
they have become beasts, and their pride does not go. ॥2॥
He created the beings of the 8.4 million species;
as my Master wills, He creates and absorbs them. ॥3॥
All are deluded, without the Word and right conduct;
only one whose guide is the Guru, the Creator, understands. ॥4॥
The Guru's servants are pleasing to the Master;
He forgives them, and they no longer depend on death's messenger. ॥5॥
Those in whose hearts the One alone is dear —
He Himself unites them and dispels their doubt. ॥6॥
He is independent, infinite and boundless;
the Creator is pleased through truth. ॥7॥
Nanak, the Guru instructs the one gone astray;
He reveals the One and fixes one in the True Lord. ॥8॥6॥
He Himself is the bumblebee, the flower and the vine;
He Himself is the congregation, uniting friends. ॥1॥
O bumblebee, take in such a fragrance
that the trees flower and the forests turn green. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself is Lakshmi, and He Himself her husband;
establishing the world by His Word, He Himself enjoys it. ॥2॥
He Himself is the calf, the cow and the milk;
He Himself is the temple, the pillar and the body. ॥3॥
He Himself is the deed and the doer;
You, the Creator, create and watch over Your creation;
You give the support of Your light to countless beings. ॥5॥
You are the lake and the ocean, deep in virtue;
You are without lineage, immaculate, the supreme diamond. ॥6॥
You Yourself are the Creator, able to do all;
O King, You are pure; Your people are at peace. ॥7॥
Nanak, one is satisfied by the taste of the Lord's Name;
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਜਨਮੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੮॥੭॥
without the Lord and the Beloved Guru, life is wasted. ॥8॥7॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਨਉ ਸਤ ਚਉਦਹ ਤੀਨਿ ਚਾਰਿ; ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ, ਚਾਰਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
Nine regions, seven continents, fourteen worlds, three realms and four ages You made, and You settled the mansion through the four sources of creation.
ਚਾਰੇ ਦੀਵੇ. ਚਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਦੀਏ; ਏਕਾ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
You placed the four lamps in the hands of the four ages, each in its turn. ॥1॥
ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧੌ; ਐਸੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Merciful Lord, Destroyer of demons, Master of Maya — such is Your power. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ॥
Your light in each and every home is Your army, and the Righteous Judge rules over it.
ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇਗ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕ ਵੇਰਾ; ਭਾਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
The earth is a cooking pot given once and for all; destiny is Your storekeeper. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਸਾਬੂਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ, ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੈ; ਨਾਰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
The mind is not content and keeps asking again; the restless Narad brings disgrace.
